items.title: The first real Rewrite play
items.summary: Rewrite support is built and tested against the client's source. A genuine Rewrite 0.1.2 replay going all the way through will prove it end to end.

items.title: Automatic bans
items.summary: Flagged plays always go to a person.

items.title: A tidier Discord
items.summary: Players see the rankings first; patch notes become something players opt into with a role, and channels about building the project stay with staff.

items.title: Revisiting provisional values
items.summary: Some mod and scoring values are first estimates. We'll review them once more players have submitted.

items.title: A name of our own for the points
items.summary: Community Ranked gets its own word for its points, instead of borrowing one.

items.title: More progression systems
items.summary: Quests, seasons and streak rewards. The profile level and medals stay, but the ranking is only about plays.

items.title: A cleaner, more professional website
items.summary: A calmer look across the site, a simpler home page and roadmap, and plainer wording.

items.title: Grade letters in Discord look like the replay's
items.summary: The bot's grade emojis and score cards show the bare grade letter in its colour, the same as the website and the replay viewer.

items.title: Medals that show what they ask for
items.summary: Every medal's picture and name now say what it takes, like "5★ Pass" or "99% on 5★".

items.title: A steady replay screen
items.summary: The numbers around the play stay still while the camera follows the cursor.

items.title: Cleaner grade letters
items.summary: Grades on the website are drawn like the replay viewer's: the letter alone, in its colour.

items.title: Replays on a phone
items.summary: Full screen works on phones, and the map leaderboard sits under the play.

items.title: Songs for more maps
items.summary: A curator can let the website play a map's song with its replays; maps nobody has said yes to still play silently.

items.title: Audio offset in the replay viewer
items.summary: If the song sounds early or late on your speakers or earbuds, a slider lines it up.

items.title: Held plays keep their reasons private
items.summary: When a play is held for a curator's check, the public reply only says it is being checked; the reasons go to the curators, not to the channel.

items.title: A clear route from the home page to the submit steps
items.summary: The home page links straight to how to submit, the empty podium spots do too, and the public site's tab says "How to submit".

items.title: A how-to-submit walkthrough
items.summary: Illustrated steps on the Submit page that show finding the replay and sending it in, drawn so no recording is needed.

items.title: A quieter login button
items.summary: Logging in on the website only highlights your own plays. The button now looks like it, and the header is two tidy rows on a phone.

items.title: A shorter Maps page on a phone
items.summary: Maps show two to a row on a phone, with a "Show more" button instead of every map at once.

items.title: A friendlier profile before your first ranked play
items.summary: A profile with no ranked plays yet shows dashes and a hint, instead of zeros that look like a bug.

items.title: Helpful not-found pages
items.summary: A wrong or old link now says what wasn't found and where to go, and a page that fails to load offers a retry.

items.title: A loading line while a page fetches
items.summary: A short "Loading…" shows while a page's data arrives, so nothing looks broken on a slow connection.

items.title: Tabs that show they scroll on a phone
items.summary: The tab row fades where it continues, and the tab you're on scrolls into view.

items.title: A way for players to ask to be removed
items.summary: Players can ask to have their profile taken off the public site.

items.title: The challenge pool table explained
items.summary: The pool page says what its Sheet and Stars columns mean.

items.title: A shorter challenge-sheet page: search, and 20 maps per tier with Show more
items.summary: The sheet page listed all 500-odd maps at once, which on a phone is minutes of scrolling. Now a search box finds a map or mapper, and each tier shows 20 rows with a Show more button.

items.title: A play's PP is its own
items.summary: Best plays used to show a smaller 'counts' figure beside a play's PP. Patch 20 removed the weighting: a play now shows and counts its full PP, and the total is the plain sum.

items.title: Repeated attempts grouped on a player page
items.summary: Retrying one map many times no longer fills your Recent list: the attempts are grouped into one row.

items.title: Calmer replay numbers
items.summary: The accuracy, combo and PP in a replay react gently to hits, so they stay readable.

items.title: Resubmitting says what to do
items.summary: Send a new run of the same map as often as you like to beat your score. Only the exact same replay file is refused, and the message now says so.

items.title: Easier with a screen reader
items.summary: After you open a page, a screen reader hears its title instead of the whole page.

items.title: Rows and tables that show they scroll on a phone
items.summary: Wide tables and a player page's section row fade at the edge they continue past, instead of looking cut off.

items.title: A new look for the website
items.summary: Rankings, player and map pages, medals and phones share one design with the replay viewer.

items.title: The Submit page is a proper how-to
items.summary: It says which maps count, where to run the command, what to do if the bot doesn't know your map, and what the bot's reply means.

items.title: A play on an unranked map says how to nominate it
items.summary: When your play lands on a map that isn't ranked, the bot's reply tells you how to nominate it.

items.title: The welcome post points to the ranked map list
items.summary: The Discord welcome and /help send you to the website's Maps page for the list of ranked maps, and say the bot replies to every submit.

items.title: Easier to read and use
items.summary: Stronger contrast, and charts, search boxes and tables labelled for screen readers.

items.title: Compare two players
items.summary: On the website and with /compare in Discord: the maps you both played, who is ahead on each, and the biggest gaps.

items.title: Double-sending a replay is handled
items.summary: Sending the same replay twice at once saves it once and says so, instead of showing an error.

items.title: Map of the week
items.summary: The Monday roundup spotlights one ranked challenge-sheet map, taking each in turn.

items.title: A star filter on the Maps page
items.summary: Narrow the list to under 3★, 3–5★, 5–7★ or 7★+.

items.title: Nomination status for players
items.summary: After /nominate, players can see where their nominated map stands.

items.title: The website says when the bot is offline
items.summary: If the site hasn't heard from the bot in a few hours, every page says so.

items.title: A heads-up when the formula changes
items.summary: If everyone is re-scored, the Discord gets a short note with the biggest rank changes.

items.title: A public roadmap
items.summary: This page: what is being worked on, what is next, and what is finished.

items.title: Community stats page
items.summary: Plays and players per week, and Nightly versus Rewrite.

items.title: Website buttons in Discord
items.summary: Every result, profile, map and #1 post links to the website.

items.title: An archive of weekly roundups
items.summary: Past weekly roundups, kept on the website so anyone can look back.

items.title: The challenge pool
items.summary: Maps on the community sheet are ranked automatically, and anyone can /nominate a map.

items.title: Score cards, roles, medals and a weekly roundup
items.summary: The bot scores each play the moment it's sent in, with score cards, roles, medals and a weekly roundup.

items.title: Fair play checks
items.summary: Every replay is re-checked before it counts, and anything that looks wrong is held for a person to look at.

items.title: Star ratings and PP for Nightly and Rewrite
items.summary: One shared, replay-backed ranking for both clients.

items.title: Rankings, map and player pages, and a replay viewer
items.summary: The website, with a replay viewer that looks like the game.
